embedded_capabilities.requirement: evaluate every processed telemetry event against a reviewed non-empty typed rule set
invoke one extension action for every rule match
execute a four-step stateful workflow with one external notification action
durably request a device command and correlate one terminal device outcome
emit one typed terminal outcome for each extension action, workflow, and command
bound direct-edge retries and capture terminal failure
authenticate workload-to-workload calls without long-lived embedded credentials
provide a managed or explicitly provider-hosted device ingress and command boundary
for every remote Six-layer responsibility edge, use a source-owned durable outbox and acknowledge it only after authenticated destination acceptance

event_layer_capabilities.requirement: validate the canonical versioned event envelope before publish and consume
route on bounded event type and metadata
add named independent consumers without producer changes
deliver at least once with stable event and invocation identifiers
capture the full safe event after terminal delivery failure
retain and explicitly replay or redrive events
support consumer deduplication by stable event and invocation identifiers
preserve order within one device partition and document degradation
reject unsupported event type or schema version to a terminal failure path
measure publish, delivery, retry, backlog, dead-letter, replay, and bridge failure
use source-owned durable forwarding with destination acceptance before source acknowledgement
attribute broker, adapter, workflow, retention, observability, and transfer costs exactly once
